from solution import is_lower


def test_issue_example_invalid():
    """Example: is_lower("InValid") == "invalid"."""
    assert is_lower("InValid") == "invalid"  # hand: I->i, V->v, rest same = "invalid"


def test_issue_all_uppercase():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case."""
    assert is_lower("HELLO") == "hello"  # hand: H->h, E->e, L->l, L->l, O->o = "hello"


def test_issue_already_lowercase():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case leaves lowercase unchanged."""
    assert is_lower("hello") == "hello"  # hand: 5 chars already lower + 0 changes = "hello"


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case for empty input."""
    assert is_lower("") == ""  # hand: 0 chars + 0 changes = ""


def test_issue_single_uppercase_letter():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case for a single letter."""
    assert is_lower("A") == "a"  # hand: A->a, 1 char = "a"


def test_issue_single_lowercase_letter():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case for a single lower letter."""
    assert is_lower("z") == "z"  # hand: z stays z, 1 char = "z"


def test_issue_mixed_case_with_space():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case preserves spaces."""
    assert is_lower("Hello World") == "hello world"  # hand: H->h, W->w, 9+2=11 chars = "hello world"


def test_issue_digits_and_symbols_unchanged():
    """Rule: convert the given string to lower case leaves digits and symbols."""
    assert is_lower("ABC123!@#") == "abc123!@#"  # hand: A->a, B->b, C->c, 3 letters + 6 others = "abc123!@#"


def test_contract_returns_string():
    """Contract: convert the given string to lower case returns a string."""
    assert isinstance(is_lower("AbC"), str)  # hand: result type check, 1 check = True


def test_contract_preserves_length():
    """Contract: convert the given string to lower case preserves length."""
    assert len(is_lower("AbCDe")) == 5  # hand-counted: len 5 = 2 upper + 3 mixed = 5 chars


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Contract: convert the given string to lower case does not modify input."""
    s = "AbC"
    is_lower(s)
    assert s == "AbC"  # hand: 3 chars, A-b-C unchanged, 2+1=3 chars
